go_no_go_plans.minimum_duration: 1 month for feasibility validation, 12+ months for full research
data_quality_checks: Non-zero positive volume during market hours
go_no_go_plans.development_gate: Minimum 20 distinct sessions, return magnitude >= 15bps in 60% dev split
go_no_go_plans.locked_gate: Statistically significant return in 20% locked holdout
go_no_go_plans.negative_controls: Wrong window control, symbol permutation control, sector placebo
go_no_go_plans.cost_proxy_without_bidask: Apply 3.0 bps fixed index cost proxy
go_no_go_plans.decision_threshold_to_buy_full_dataset: Survives negative controls with > 10bps net edge on 1-month sample
go_no_go_plans.decision_threshold_to_reject_dataset_pur: Fails negative controls or exhibits < 5bps return in development

data_quality_checks: Basis boundary check (basis within +/- 2.5% of spot)
go_no_go_plans.negative_controls: Wrong time window, basis sign inversion, expiry placebo
go_no_go_plans.decision_threshold_to_buy_full_dataset: Survives negative controls with > 8bps net edge
go_no_go_plans.decision_threshold_to_reject_dataset_pur: Fails negative controls or zero development survivors
